intro.fr: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Sucker Punch Productions sort Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves en 2010.
text.en: Sucker Punch Productions releases Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves in 2010.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub NikolajDanger/ApSly3, qui héberge l'APWorld de Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves.
text.en: The GitHub repository NikolajDanger/ApSly3, home of the Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v0.3.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (5 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v0.3.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (5 versions released).

text.fr: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Sly 3: Honor Among Thieves is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
